rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a story or narrative.

example.english: This tale is about when I was little.
example.traditional: 呢個故事係講我細個嗰陣嘅事。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 hai6 gong2 ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ge3 si6

rows.note: Use this for gossip or idle, sensational talk rather than a normal narrative.

example.english: Everyone in the café is swapping that gossipy tale.
example.traditional: 茶記入面個個都講緊八卦。
example.jyutping: caa4 gei3 jap6 min6 go3 go3 dou1 gong2 gan2 baat3 gwaa3

rows.note: Use this when the tale is a rumour or an unverified report.

example.english: I heard a tale that they are moving abroad.
example.traditional: 我聽過一個傳聞，話佢要移民。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 gwo3 jat1 go3 cyun4 man4 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 ji4 man4

rows.note: Use this when the tale is specifically a lie or false account.

example.english: The tale you are telling is a lie; it will not fool me.
example.traditional: 你講嘅大話呃唔到我㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 ge3 daai6 waa6 ngaak1 m4 dou2 ngo5 gaa3
